answer.answer: AAPL's reported revenue series holds 339 points, and I walked it to the end: the first page returned 200 of 339, and the follow-up cursor page returned the remaining 139 with next_cursor null, so the series is complete and not truncated at the end. Earliest period: 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29 (reported 24,006,000,000 USD in the 10-K accession 0001193125-09-214859). Latest period: 2026-03-29 to 2026-06-27 (reported 109,417,000,000 USD in the 10-Q accession 0000320193-26-000020). All points are held in state SOURCE_REPORTED. Two things qualify how the series may be read. First, the series is not one continuous measure: the registry maps us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet as PARTIAL (effective 2007-09-29 to 2018-06-30) and us-gaap:Revenues as PARTIAL (2016-09-24 to 2018-09-29), with two recorded CONCEPT_MAPPING_BREAKs at 2007-09-29 and 2016-09-24, so periods before 2017-09-30 are a different, narrower concept from periods after. Only from 2017-09-30 onward is the mapping EXACT (us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax). Second, the point count is a count of observations, not of distinct reporting periods: many periods are reported by several filings, so the same period appears more than once. The earliest period is the only ambiguity in identification: it is reported as 24,006,000,000 by accession 0001193125-09-214859 and as 24,578,000,000 by accession 0001193125-10-012091, both for 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29; ST-EVA records the ambiguity and has selected no winner, so the earliest period's start and end dates are settled but its value is not. Every observation carries validation_status UNVERIFIABLE, meaning no figure was cross-checked against a second source.
uncertainties: The earliest period 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29 carries two different reported values (24,006,000,000 and 24,578,000,000 USD) from different filings; the evidence does not establish which filing is authoritative and no winner was selected.
The 339 points are observations, not 339 distinct reporting periods; the same period is often reported by several filings, so the number of distinct periods in the series is not established here.

The series spans three different source concepts, two of them mapped PARTIAL rather than EXACT, with two recorded concept-mapping breaks; a single continuous time series across the full 2006-2026 range is not what the evidence supports.
All observations are UNVERIFIABLE, so no figure in the series was cross-validated against an independent source.

One point in the final page (obsarch_7429c7068c9299b29190bfba) is a vendor quote from YahooFinance that ST-EVA left unresolved against any registry mapping, so it is held in the revenue metric without a source concept; its status is not settled by a mapping.
The evidence does not state why any value is what it is; no explanation of the figures or the concept changes was returned.
